- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Themes of love and relationships are a staple of pop music and are relatable to many people, evoking strong emotions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Love and relationships are universal topics that transcend cultural, linguistic, and geographical barriers, making them accessible to a broad audience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pop music fosters a shared experience and sense of connection among people worldwide.
